name: GlzCapsule
semanticRole: Represent one coherent temporary floating task such as search, media, selection, status, progress, quick actions, or command entry without becoming a catch-all system dashboard.

material.rule: Regular Glaze is the signature default for a floating capsule; denser content or reduced-transparency contexts move toward Thick or Solid Glaze without changing task semantics.

input.keyboard: Keyboard operation follows the component's semantic role; no required action depends on pointer-only interaction.
input.focus: Focus is visible, deterministic, and restored or moved according to the component's spatial transformation.
input.hover: Hover may enrich presentation but never exposes the only path to essential information or actions.
input.press: Press feedback is immediate and does not wait for decorative animation before semantic state changes.

accessibility.role: Use a role appropriate to the coherent task; progress/status variants expose status or progress semantics and command/search variants expose their interactive control semantics.
accessibility.name: The capsule and any icon-only actions have explicit accessible names derived from the current coherent task.
accessibility.state: Expose expanded/collapsed, busy, selected, current status, and progress states programmatically.
accessibility.value: Progress variants expose the real progress value; media/search/action variants expose values through their nested controls.
accessibility.keyboard: Tab reaches actionable controls, Enter/Space invoke actions, and Escape collapses a noncritical expanded state without discarding work.
accessibility.focus: Expanding preserves a stable focus path; collapse returns focus to the compact task control when applicable.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Errors remain associated with the affected control or content and are announced without color-only meaning.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Replace spatial morphing with direct state changes or a short crossfade while preserving the same capability.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: Replace translucent material with an opaque surface while preserving hierarchy and boundaries.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen focus, boundaries, selected state, and text contrast without changing semantics.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use system colors, visible focus, and remove decorative gradients, blur, and shadows.
accessibility.largeText: Reflow at 200% text without clipping essential labels, actions, sources, or state.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Replace spatial morphing with direct state changes or a short crossfade while preserving the same capability.
fallbacks.reducedTransparency: Replace translucent material with an opaque surface while preserving hierarchy and boundaries.
fallbacks.highContrast: Strengthen focus, boundaries, selected state, and text contrast without changing semantics.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Use system colors, visible focus, and remove decorative gradients, blur, and shadows.
fallbacks.performance: Remove blur, ambient gradients, decorative shadows, and nonessential morphing before changing semantic structure, target geometry, focus, or readable contrast.

content.overflow: Long labels truncate only after preserving task identity; expanded content reflows and may scroll without hiding primary controls.
content.localization: Task labels and actions tolerate 30–50% expansion and expanded geometry grows before truncation.
content.rtl: Logical order mirrors while progress direction, media semantics, and status meaning follow locale/platform conventions.

criteria: The capsule communicates exactly one coherent temporary task.
Collapsed and expanded states feel spatially continuous without becoming visually dominant.
Reduced transparency preserves the same hierarchy with an opaque fallback.
